subject: Mutual action sprintboard: POC env provisioning (API keys, org, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novexa.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Ethan Lee <ethan.lee@novexa.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + initial asks for POC environment

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the latency profiles. We've pulled together a short mutual action plan (attached) to get the POC live next month. Can you confirm owners and approximate ETA for the items below? We're trying to close environment provisioning by Oct 6 so engineering can start the eval runs on Oct 7.

High-level asks:
- Org & tenant creation: one Novexa sandbox org (non-prod) with role-based access for our 3 engineers.
- API keys: two API keys (one ephemeral for CI, one long-lived for integration tests).
- IP allowlist: we'll supply a list of public IPs (see placeholder in the attachment) — need guidance on format and how long the entries take to propagate.
- VPC peering: Novexa wants a VPC peering for large-batch ingest (we'll provide VPC IDs).

I've attached the MAP (PDF) and a CSV stub for our network team. If you can confirm owners & the ideal dates for each item by end of day tomorrow, we can align procurement and networking on our side.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, Novexa.ai
Attachments: Novexa-MAP-v1.2.pdf (47KB), novexa-network-cidrs.csv (1KB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novexa.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + initial asks for POC environment

Hi Samira — great to hear the demo resonated. Thanks for sending the MAP and the CSV. Below I've broken the asks into owners and target dates so we have a single alignment board. Please confirm if any of these dates are a hard constraint for your side.

Owners & proposed timeline (target dates are Redwood local estimates):
1) Org & tenant creation — owner: Olga Petrov — target: 2026-09-24
   - Deliverable: Novexa sandbox org + 3 engineer accounts (RBAC).
   - Notes: we'll create a separate admin user for your SRE team; share SSO IdP metadata if you want SAML.

2) API keys issuance — owner: Jordan Blake — target: 2026-09-25
   - Deliverable: 1 ephemeral key (30d TTL, CI) + 1 integration key (rotate every 90d).
   - Notes: Jordan will add the keys to a scoped service account and return the key IDs and a bootstrap script.

3) IP allowlist ingestion — owner: Neha Kapoor (Networking liaise) — target: 2026-09-27
   - Deliverable: confirm accepted CSV schema, ingestion ETA, and whether support for CIDR ranges is available.
   - Notes: provide expected 24-hour propagation SLA after entry.

4) VPC peering request & config — owner: Karthik Iyer (Infra) — target: 2026-09-30 (request), peering complete by 2026-10-04
   - Deliverable: peering accept/route table updates + manifest of endpoints used for batch ingest.

Immediate asks for you:
- Reply with final public IP list (or confirm you'll use the attached CSV)
- Provide the VPC ID & an engineering contact for peering (name + email + preferred maintenance window)
- Procurement contact for PO/contract redlines so our finance team can prioritize.

I'll queue the internal tasks in the MAP board and mark dates as tentative until we hear back. Forwarding to Jordan and Neha to pick up the API keys and allowlist work.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Sent from my laptop
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novexa.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Lee <ethan.lee@novexa.ai>, procurement@novexa.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + initial asks for POC environment

Thanks Olga — confirmed. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- IP list attached (novexa-network-cidrs.csv). These are our egress addresses from the ingestion cluster. We prefer the entries to be stored for 90 days and will notify you if they change.
- VPC: our VPC ID is vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, contact for peering is Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@novexa.ai> (network eng), preferred window: 2026-10-01 01:00-03:00 UTC.
- Procurement: procurement@novexa.ai — PO process typically takes 5–7 business days once redline is agreed.

Also: small ask about API keys — can the ephemeral key be limited to token-only non-admin scope? We want to prevent accidental admin calls from CI.

Apologies — attaching the final CSV and a short addendum to the MAP with the above details.

Best,
Samira

Attachments: novexa-network-cidrs.csv (1KB), Novexa-MAP-addendum.txt (2KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novexa.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + initial asks for POC environment

Hi Samira — looping in infra & networking to confirm. Quick updates from our side:

- API key scoping: yes — the ephemeral CI key will be created with a restricted token-only role (no admin). We'll provide the bootstrap snippet and a one-click revoke URL. Expected delivery: 2026-09-25 EOD.
- IP allowlist: Neha confirmed the CSV schema and ingestion pipeline; we will ingest and schedule propagation within 24 hours of entry. Neha — please proceed once Samira confirms the final CSV (attached).
- VPC peering: Karthik has opened a peering request ticket (PR-7812) and scheduled the maintenance window for 2026-10-01 01:00-03:00 UTC as requested. Peering acceptance is pending on Novexa's side (Aaron).
- Org creation: Olga completed the sandbox org today; credentials and SSO options were shared via secure link (DM sent).

Next steps / owners recap:
- Samira / Aaron: accept peering request PR-7812 and confirm route acceptance after the scheduled window.
- Procurement: procurement@novexa.ai to send PO or redlines to billing@redwood.ai; finance will hold the account open pending PO (5–7 business days typical).
- Jordan: deliver keys + bootstrap script by 2026-09-25 EOD.
- Neha: ingest CIDRs once the final CSV is approved (24h propagation window).

We're marking the MAP items as on-track for a POC readiness date of 2026-10-05. If procurement runs long, the environment will still be usable for evaluation but some production features (reserved throughput) may be gated until purchase is complete.

Thanks — we'll post all updates to the shared MAP doc and the HubSpot deal link.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Platform Solutions | Redwood Inference
